name: Leticia Dominguez
prior_offices: Goshen County treasurer (the official treasurer page lists her in that office; county salary publications used here for job titles only list her as treasurer; she won the 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Leticia Dominguez is the Goshen County treasurer and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official treasurer page lists her in that office. County salary publications (used here for job titles only) list her as treasurer.
